g.text: One Firehose vs. Many Small Trickles
The same total fetch rate, spent two very different ways
Every worker just pops whatever is next -- nothing
stops five of them from all popping Domain A at once.
Domain A -- one request, then wait
Domain B -- one request, then wait
Domain C -- one request, then wait
Each domain gets its own crawl-delay clock -- a slow, independent trickle,
never a burst -- while the frontier still serves thousands of domains in parallel.
